description: The difference of two \(A\)-definable tuple sets is \(A\)-definable.
signature:
Set.Definable.sdiff.{u, v, w, u₁} {M : Type w} {A : Set M} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u₁}
  {s t : Set (α → M)} (hs : A.Definable L s) (ht : A.Definable L t) : A.Definable L (s \ t)
